text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 40, "unit": "years", "kind": "count", "span": "works for 40 years"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 50000, "unit": "$", "kind": "money", "span": "annual pension of $50,000/year"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 20, "unit": "years", "kind": "count", "span": "starting after 20 years"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 0.05, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "5% of the value of the pension per year"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 30, "unit": "years", "kind": "count", "span": "quits after 30 years"}], "plan": [{"op": "sub", "args": ["q5", "q3"], "out": "s1", "note": "years worked beyond the 20-year threshold"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["s1", "q4"], "out": "s2", "note": "fraction of the full pension she is entitled to"}, {"op": "mul", "args": ["q2", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "her annual pension amount"}], "target": {"kind": "money", "scope": "Marcy's annual pension if she quits after 30 years"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 40, "reason": "the 40-year full-tenure figure is a baseline reference not needed once the 5%-per-year-after-20 rate is applied at year 30"}]}
